items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: "Lucky Millinder, very good out there in front of directing. (Inaudible) remind me of each other. But Savoy days, during those days, were some years."

ctx.x: Yeah. I never saw him play anything. He used to have the baton. I never knew what he played.

I think, I think I heard someone say something about the drummer, but I'm not sure. But, he used to have a very good band. He used to go and Lucky Millinder, very good out there in front of directing. (Inaudible) remind me of each other.
But Savoy days, during those days, were some years. Charlie Buchanan was the manager. I'm pretty sure you heard of him. But, he brought those bands in there and the boys,
